claims: In the saved static caller FUN_001ce288, each loop iteration calls FUN_00128ca0 before FUN_001288b0; if another outer iteration follows, the next 00128ca0 comes after the preceding iteration's 001288b0 call.
In FUN_001288b0, a nonzero count at record+0x1c or record+0x28 enters a loop that calls FUN_00128e88; this is conditional on the count and is not guaranteed on every iteration.

When FUN_00128e88 is called, it appends STMOD 0 and STCYCL 4/4 after its geometry UNPACK packet commands and before its MSCNT, so these explicit command words occur earlier in the shared output buffer than a subsequent outer loop's V4-32 builder.

The conditional source trace does not prove the next V4-32 transfer has effective MODE=0 and CL/WL=4/4 because FUN_0010f8f8 between iterations emits a computed DMA tag/reference whose transferred contents and TTE effects are not fully reconstructed.

evidence.text: Saved FUN_001ce288.c has loop body calls in order: FUN_00128ca0(auStack_c0); FUN_001335f8; FUN_00133a90; FUN_001288b0(...); FUN_00129bc0; FUN_00126e28; then increments iVar7 and repeats while iVar7<iVar6.
Saved FUN_001288b0.c: `if (*(short *)(iVar3 + 0x1c) != 0)` loops `uVar12` times and calls FUN_00128e88; later `if (*(short *)(iVar3 + 0x28) != 0)` loops `uVar12` times and calls FUN_00128e88.

Saved FUN_00128e88.c emits geometry packet data then stores STMOD 0, STCYCL 4/4, MSCNT, BASE, OFFSET at the advancing shared output cursor. Saved FUN_0010f8f8.c, called before the V4-32 sequence in FUN_00128ca0.c, includes a computed 64-bit DMA-tag word and qword 0x4e; the tag's exact referenced contents/TTE effects are not established in these excerpts.
